message.text: save() calls regularOrAbsent on the temporary path, which throws a plain Error with the raw path. It runs outside measureHeld's try/catch, and measureParity only escapes LostLock, so the error leaves with ESC and bidi bytes intact.

explanation.what: save() calls regularOrAbsent on the temporary path, which throws a plain Error with the raw path. It runs outside measureHeld's try/catch, and measureParity only escapes LostLock, so the error leaves with ESC and bidi bytes intact.
explanation.whatToDo: Wrap the path in visibleText inside regularOrAbsent's message, or catch all errors in measureParity and print visibleText(message).
explanation.whyHere: MELIAN_EVAL_PARITY_OUT is chosen by whoever sets the environment. parity-live awaits measureParity at top level, so the rejection prints the raw message to the terminal.

properties.failureScenario: Ran the head's measureParity under vitest with stub runners. The parity.test.ts harness was copied, with imports rewritten to the tree. OUT was a path containing ESC[31m and U+202E, with the directory "<OUT>.<pid>.tmp" pre-created. measureParity rejected with a message containing a raw 0x1b and U+202E, where the take refusals are escaped. parity-live has no catch, so the terminal gets the raw bytes.
